links.outcome: Reproducibility of chatbot responses when same questions re-queried after 1, 7, and 14 days
links.effect: All 3 AI models demonstrated consistent response patterns when the same questions were re-queried after 1, 7, and 14 days; all models exhibited good reproducibility.
links.quote: All 3 AI models demonstrated consistent response patterns when the same questions were re-queried after 1, 7, and 14 days.

links.outcome: Occasional high-risk errors in AI answers to drug-related questions, including pregnancy and lactation
links.effect: Limited accuracy and occasional high-risk errors; pregnancy and lactation category had the highest high-risk response rate (1/76, 1% per system); risk level differed by question type (P=.04).
links.quote: The evaluated AI chatbots were able to answer the queries with generally complete content; however, we found limited accuracy and occasional high-risk errors in responding to drug-related questions in Thai.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot) answering Thai drug information questions assessed by clinical pharmacists, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
